content: Hey Susie, can I borrow your car tonight?
No, the last time you borrowed it, you returned it with the gas tank empty.
Did I? I'm sorry baby. I promise to fill the tank this time.
What do you need it for?
I want to take my mom out to dinner.
You can come if you want. I thought she'd probably have plans with your friends.
I do, but I'd rather go with you. Don't you think it's time for me to meet your mother?
OK, sure. Just don't expect her to love you right away. She never thinks any girl is good enough for me.
